name: lockdocs
tagline: Exact-version library docs from your lockfile — local, offline, no rate limits or API keys.
description: Local Rust MCP server (`@sylphx/lockdocs`) that reads your project's lockfiles (npm, pnpm, Yarn, Bun, uv, Poetry, Pipfile, Cargo, Go) and answers from the docs, READMEs, changelogs, and API declarations (`.d.ts`, Python docstrings/stubs, rustdoc, Go doc) of the exact dependency versions installed — including private and internal packages. Uses hybrid BM25 + local embedding retrieval with token-budgeted, `file:line`-cited answers and no API key or query quota. Exposes three MCP tools: `resolve` (inspect pinned versions and doc sources), `docs` (search installed library docs and pinned upstream release-tag docs), and `api` (exact symbol signatures, overloads, and doc comments).

install.notes: Requires Node.js 18+. Runs locally over stdio with no API key or account required. Automatically resolves your workspace's lockfiles; set LOCKDOCS_OFFLINE=1 to prohibit all network requests.
